FIXED AS PHYSICS before anything recorded PROVED: component_roster now derives from device_census (charter_on_disk filter); a composition tooth (gamma: code without charter — census sees it, roster must not) and the import-allowlist tooth (cairn.orient.orient the ONLY cairn import) pin it; 12 teeth re-green twice, re-sealed under netns. Live fire completed on the composed floor: request grounded (4 components + 5 paths/records, all verified; roster_size 19), ceiling assembled the packet with 4 honest unknowns and confidence 0.72 as data, gate passed, berthed at ~/.cairn/devices/chart/0/packets/orient-20260728T110828-63dcfc770585.json — the first inspectable orientation.
